chunks: And string him to a chain seventy cubits long.
ai.seo_question: What is the length of the chains used to bind the disbelievers in Hell according to Surah Al-Haqqah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Haqqa (69:32) is often interpreted as describing the physical chains of Hell, with the 'seventy cubits' signifying the immense length and weight of the bonds that prevent escape. This imagery underscores the finality of divine retribution for those who denied the truth, serving as a vivid contrast to the spiritual freedom of the righteous. The specificity of the measurement highlights the tangible reality of the afterlife in Islamic cosmology.
